module.purpose: Defines the React-specific router factory and Router subclass, extending core routing with React component options and store integration.
module.summary: This module augments the core router options with React components, wrappers, and error handling callbacks. It exposes a factory that constructs the React-aware Router subclass, whose constructor delegates core initialization while supplying the React store factory. The resulting instance is intended for use with RouterProvider and route trees.
module.businessContext: Supports application navigation, route rendering, and data-loading error states in React applications. Failure prevents router initialization or integration with the React rendering layer.

typeShapes.name: RouterOptionsExtensions
typeShapes.shape:
{
    /**
     * The default `component` a route should use if no component is provided.
     *
     * @default Outlet
     * @link [API Docs](https://tanstack.com/router/latest/docs/framework/react/api/router/RouterOptionsType#defaultcomponent-property)
     */
    defaultComponent?: RouteComponent
    /**
     * The default `errorComponent` a route should use if no error component is provided.
     *
     * @default ErrorComponent
     * @link [API Docs](https://tanstack.com/router/latest/docs/framework/react/api/router/RouterOptionsType#defaulterrorcomponent-property)
     * @link [Guide](https://tanstack.com/router/latest/docs/framework/react/guide/data-loading#handling-errors-with-routeoptionserrorcomponent)
     */
    defaultErrorComponent?: ErrorRouteComponent
    /**
     * The default `pendingComponent` a route should use if no pending component is provided.
     *
     * @link [API Docs](https://tanstack.com/router/latest/docs/framework/react/api/router/RouterOptionsType#defaultpendingcomponent-property)
     * @link [Guide](https://tanstack.com/router/latest/docs/framework/react/guide/data-loading#showing-a-pending-component)
     */
    defaultPendingComponent?: RouteComponent
    /**
     * The default `notFoundComponent` a route should use if no notFound component is provided.
     *
     * @default NotFound
     * @link [API Docs](https://tanstack.com/router/latest/docs/framework/react/api/router/RouterOptionsType#defaultnotfoundcomponent-property)
     * @link [Guide](https://tanstack.com/router/latest/docs/framework/react/guide/not-found-errors#default-router-wide-not-found-handling)
     */
    defaultNotFoundComponent?: NotFoundRouteComponent
    /**
     * A component that will be used to wrap the entire router.
     *
     * This is useful for providing a context to the entire router.
     *
     * Only non-DOM-rendering components like providers should be used, anything else will cause a hydration error.
     *
     * @link [API Docs](https://tanstack.com/router/latest/docs/framework/react/api/router/RouterOptionsType#wrap-property)
     */
    Wrap?: (props: { children: any }) => React.JSX.Element
    /**
     * A component that will be used to wrap the inner contents of the router.
     *
     * This is useful for providing a context to the inner contents of the router where you also need access to the router context and hooks.
     *
     * Only non-DOM-rendering components like providers should be used, anything else will cause a hydration error.
     *
     * @link [API Docs](https://tanstack.com/router/latest/docs/framework/react/api/router/RouterOptionsType#innerwrap-property)
     */
    InnerWrap?: (props: { children: any }) => React.JSX.Element

    /**
     * The default `onCatch` handler for errors caught by the Router ErrorBoundary
     *
     * @link [API Docs](https://tanstack.com/router/latest/docs/framework/react/api/router/RouterOptionsType#defaultoncatch-property)
     * @link [Guide](https://tanstack.com/router/latest/docs/framework/react/guide/data-loading#handling-errors-with-routeoptionsoncatch)
     */
    defaultOnCatch?: (error: Error, errorInfo: React.ErrorInfo) => void
  }

edgeCases.inputShape: Router options with optional React defaults omitted
edgeCases.behavior: The options are passed unchanged to the router core, allowing core or route-level defaults to apply.

edgeCases.inputShape: Router options containing wrapper or error callback components
edgeCases.behavior: React-specific options are available through the module-augmented RouterOptionsExtensions contract.

edgeCases.inputShape: Invalid or incomplete router constructor options
edgeCases.behavior: No local validation or fallback is performed; the superclass receives the options and determines failure behavior.

invariants.description: The factory returns a newly constructed Router instance.
Router construction always supplies getStoreFactory to the core constructor.
Router preserves the generic route tree, trailing slash, history, and dehydration types.

assumptions.description: Callers provide valid RouterConstructorOptions and pass the resulting instance to RouterProvider.
The route tree and context requirements are satisfied by the caller when constructing the router.
React.JSX and React.ErrorInfo types are available to consumers of the augmented interface.

ambiguities.question: What validation and error behavior does RouterCore apply to malformed constructor options?
What concrete store behavior is provided by getStoreFactory?

concurrencyModel.notes: Factory and constructor execute synchronously; asynchronous routing behavior is delegated to RouterCore.
